seasonseries.title: Birmingham City vs. Queens Park Rangers

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Jhon Solís (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Birmingham City 1, Queens Park Rangers 0. Liam Millar (Birmingham City) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Tomoki Iwata following a fast break.
Harvey Vale (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Birmingham City 1, Queens Park Rangers 0.
Goal! Birmingham City 2, Queens Park Rangers 0. Liam Millar (Birmingham City) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Tomoki Iwata.
Rayan Kolli (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Max Bird replaces Jhon Solís.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Carlos Vicente replaces Patrick Roberts.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Richard Kone replaces Rayan Kolli.
Christoph Klarer (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Demarai Gray replaces Liam Millar.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Jonathan Varane replaces Jake Clarke-Salter.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Koki Saito replaces Paul Smyth.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Leon Scarlett replaces Glen Kamara.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Luis Vázquez replaces August Priske.
Goal! Birmingham City 3, Queens Park Rangers 0. Demarai Gray (Birmingham City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Luis Vázquez.
Delay in match because of an injury Richard Kone (Queens Park Rangers).
